title: NoTrain AI crawler list
description: Web crawlers and fetchers operated for AI purposes. Used by the creator tool (robots.txt / ai.txt generator). Regular search-engine crawlers (Googlebot, Bingbot, ...) do not belong here.

token.description: The product token matched against `User-agent:` lines in robots.txt (RFC 9309 section 2.2.1), e.g. "GPTBot". Unique, case-insensitively.

operator.description: Company or project that runs the crawler. Used to group entries in generated files.

purpose.description: training = collects data to train models; search = indexes pages for AI search/answers; user-triggered = fetches a page because a user asked an assistant to; mixed = more than one of these, including training.

respectsRobotsTxt.description: Whether the operator documents that it honours robots.txt and whether that holds in practice (false if credibly reported to ignore it).

docsUrl.description: The operator's documentation for this crawler, or the best public source if there is none.

notes.description: One or two plain sentences shown as a comment in generated files.
